title: Soccer Jersey Design (2026)
verdict: Soccer jersey design in 2026 rewards clubs that keep it simple: a pattern with history, a crest with room around it and a color nobody else in the league wears. Wooter's builder has soccer styles to start from, and its designers will draw yours for free.
Custom Ink handles printed designs on stock kits. Champro and Nike Team offer template libraries through dealers. Boombah's builder is another place to try layouts.

why: Soccer has a short list of patterns that everyone recognizes: vertical stripes, hoops, halves, a sash, a single chest band. Choosing one ties a new club to a hundred years of the game.
Color does the rest. Look at who you play and pick what they do not wear. A distinctive color saves you from changing kits every other week.
Leave space around the crest and keep the sponsor to one color where you can. Wooter's designers will mock up options from a short brief in 1 to 2 business days.

faq.q: What are the classic soccer jersey designs?
faq.a: Stripes, hoops, halves, quarters, a sash and a chest band. Solid with contrast trim is the most common of all.

faq.q: How do we design an away kit?
faq.a: Keep the layout and invert the colors, or move to a neutral such as white or black with club-color trim.
Centered on the chest. Check your league's rules on size.
